notes.title: Update
notes.content:
List of updates:
1) Added achievements.
2) Added Leaderboards.
3) New design.
4) Fixed known bugs.
PS: Do not hesitate to create discussions in the community and express your suggestions for improving the game. Your feedback is very important to us.
